name: Garden and patio walls along Calle Elena, Calle Jorge and Calle Cervantes
about: Walls that close gardens and patios off from Calle Elena and Calle Jorge where the model left the ground open (Dave, 2026-11-16: the walls need adding around Calle Jorge and Elena). Each wall is a polyline of [x, z] model metres, built as a white rendered wall with a slightly wider coping, solid for collision, with closed timber doors where a photo shows one. 'raise' lifts the top by the lane's own height above the site ground (Calle Jorge's path stands 0.3 m above it, src/jorge-lane.ts), so 'height' is read from the path the photos were taken on. Levels and reasons are in data/confidence.json. Not a property survey: positions are photo pins, the registry and the Esri aerial, good to about 1 m.

walls.name: Elena south · white wall with two brown doors west of the junction lawns
walls.basis: IMG_2261 and IMG_2260 look south down the Elena lawns and IMG_2358 looks down on them from a roof north of Cervantes: a plain white wall about 2.2 m high, a little taller than its two brown doors, runs along the whole west side of both lawns behind a narrow bed with trained bougainvillea, from the Cervantes corner to the wall with the cypresses at the far end, which the model draws as the north face of registry 6265801UF1366N_part5. One door is at the end of the tiled cross-path between the lawns and the other in the bed a few metres north; IMG_2330 shows both from the lane. The doors stand where the red-tread sills of data/door_sills.json already are (elena-lawn-door-sill, elena-bed-door-sill), and the wall's outer face runs through them, with the lawn door about 0.4 m further back as the far door in IMG_2261 is set in. North of the bed door the wall keeps about 0.6 m outside the traced edge of lawn 1 (data/frontage_divisions.json) and meets the existing Cervantes south patio wall (data/cervantes_patio_walls.json, cervantes-patio-south-2). Heights by eye against the doors; the line is about 1 m. 17 November 2026 (task elena-junction-lawns-roof, refitted after review): measured through two solved roof cameras, ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17.jpg and IMG_2358 re-solved with its parapet, and checked on the Esri aerial. The photographed wall foot runs straight from the Cervantes south wall for about 8.6 m past the bed door (ten foot points from both cameras on one line, 0.09 m rms); the first trace had it 1.4 m further west at the north end with a 1.1 m jog. The wall is now that straight run, ending on the Cervantes south wall line, then the existing far length to the cypress wall (registry 6265801UF1366N_part5); the bed door and its sill sit on the straight run where both photos put the door, and the lawn door stays where the cross path ends. Foot, kerb and path points fit at 0.10 m rms (worst 0.19 m); the two held-out points on the far length, 20-24 m out, are 0.28 and 0.34 m on the lawn side, left open. See docs/reviews/elena-junction-lawns-roof.

walls.name: Elena south · low patio wall on the east side of the lane mouth
walls.basis: IMG_2358, from the roof north of Cervantes looking south-south-east down Calle Elena, shows on the left of the lane mouth a paved patio in front of a house door hung with bougainvillea, closed off from the lane by a low white wall about waist high with a hedge and the lamp post outside it. Built from the end of the existing Cervantes south wall east of Elena (data/cervantes_patio_walls.json, cervantes-patio-south-3) to the north-west corner of registry 6265601UF1366N_part1, about 1.4 m east of the lane centreline. Height by eye; whether it has a gate is not visible. The Google satellite view (Imagery © Google 2026, zoom 21, fetched 16 November 2026) shows a white line along the west edge of the red-tiled patio, which supports the lane-side line; in IMG_2358 the wall that shows clearly is the one across the patio's north side.

walls.name: Calle Jorge · tall patio wall with lantern and meter box at the east side of the cactus garden
walls.basis: IMG_2230, from about 114 m along the lane looking west, shows behind the hedged planters and a patio with a chair a tall white wall facing east with a wall lantern and a meter box on it, the candelabra tree rising behind it. Its lane end is about 10 degrees right of the lane's vanishing point, which with the camera pin puts it about 103 to 106 m along. The Esri aerial shows a white wall there, at 104.3 m, from the lane edge back to the house corner of 6364401UF1366S_part2, with the garden lawn ending against it and its shadow falling on the lawn. So the open garden ends here, not at 108.4 m as first estimated from the pins: the planter now runs from this wall (data/jorge_lane.json boundary gap, kerb and lawn end at 104.4 m). Built from the house corner to the lane edge just behind the garden kerb, 2.6 m above the path by eye against the 0.7 m planter and hedge in front of it.

walls.name: Calle Jorge · patio wall from the house corner to the planter at 117.5 m
walls.basis: Inferred from the aerial. Esri and Google show white walls at right angles to the lane on the north side where the registry houses step back (111.1, 117.7 and 124.3 m), each from the house corner forward to the planters at the lane edge. This one is the east side of the planted patio between the house rows, from the corner of 6364401UF1366S_part7 to the planter. Height taken from the photographed patio wall at 104.3 m (IMG_2230), less a little; no photo shows it. The one at 111.1 m is not built: the brick entrances in the planter, placed from photo pins, would put it between the first entrance and its patio (see discrepancy jorge-planter-gaps-vs-aerial).

walls.name: Calle Jorge · patio wall between the last patio and the plinth lawn at 124.5 m
walls.basis: Inferred from the aerial: a white wall on the line of the east face of 6364401UF1366S_part7 runs from the lane edge back to the plain lawn wall (guillermoWest in data/jorge_lane.json), the west side of the plinth lawn. Only the stretch from the house corner to the planter is missing in the model; the rest is the house face. Height as jorge-patio-wall-117.

walls.name: Cervantes west · white garden wall on the north side, Dalí exit to the Elena garden door
walls.basis: Between the Dalí exit and the Elena junction the north side of the lane is a white garden wall about 1.5-1.8 m high, with bougainvillea over it and banana leaves behind, set back behind a planted bed (IMG_2274 looking north-east, IMG_2468 and IMG_2264 looking west, IMG_2275 at the exit). The model had open paving here up to the houses 6 m back. The line, 2.0 m off the centreline, is where the three photographed patio partitions behind it end (data/cervantes_north_patios.json) and the garden door's wall stands (data/cervantes_garden_door.json), which it meets at its west end. West end at the exit planter. No door asserted: none shows from the lane, though the patios behind must have one. 17 November 2026: east end moved 1.0 m west with the garden door wall it meets (data/cervantes_garden_door.json, task elena-junction-lawns-roof).

walls.name: Cervantes · tall white wall on the south side, east of the Elena patios to Calle Alberto
walls.basis: The south side of the lane from the Elena patios to the Calle Alberto crossing is one tall plain white wall, above head height, with bougainvillea and jade at its foot: IMG_2795, IMG_2450 and IMG_2794 look west along it, IMG_2449 shows the CALLE DE MIGUEL plaque on it and IMG_2448 the ALBERTO plaque on its end at the crossing. It carries on the line of the existing wall east of Elena (data/cervantes_east_south_patios.json), which ended at 78.2 m, to the corner at about 93 m where it turns south along Calle Alberto (the ALBERTO plaque face in IMG_2448; the registry block's east face is at 93.0 m). Two brown doors in IMG_2794: one close to the camera at about 90 m, one in a capped pier opening about 6 m further west, at about 83.5 m; each is good to about 2 m. The gardens behind it are not traced.

walls.name: Cervantes south · patio wall with a brown door between the house and the Elena lawns' west wall
walls.basis: ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17.jpg looks down on a tall white wall facing Cervantes with a closed brown door, between the CALLE ELENA corner of the lawns' west wall and the house west of it, closing the patio with the parasol; IMG_2467 and IMG_2264 show it from the lane, a white wall a little taller than its door, and IMG_2262 its east end beside the CALLE ELENA face. It stands on the existing Cervantes south wall line, from the house corner (registry 6265801UF1366N_part5 corner 32, 0.23 m off the line) to the west wall's north end. The door head, cast through the solved roof camera at 2.0 m, is 0.95 m wide, 2.37 m along the wall from its west end and within about 0.2 m of the line. Height 1.9 m: the wall top casts at 1.84-1.95 m through the solved roof camera and IMG_2467 and IMG_2264 agree (structure review of 18 November; first built at 2.2 m). Built 17 November 2026 (task elena-junction-lawns-roof); it replaces the 0.65 m wall drawn here. Door 1.8 m, its head just under the coping as photographed.

walls.name: Elena south · white wall with two cypresses at the far end of the lawns
walls.basis: The far lawn ends at a plain white wall about 2 m high, with vines trained along its top and two cypresses at its foot, running from the lawns' west wall to the lane kerb: face-on in IMG_2261 and IMG_2330 from the junction, and from the Elena 24 roof in ELENA-ROOF-2026-11-17, IMG_2358 and IMG_2367; the Esri aerial has the lawn's green ending at a dark wall line. Built 0.35 m beyond the far lawn's traced edge, from the west wall to 1.0 m off the lane centreline (just short of the kerb). Its line is estimated: 22-24 m from the roof cameras the depth is good to about 1 m, and no ground camera near it is solved (photo request elena-south-cypress-wall-gate). Before this the model had open paving here and drew the north face of registry 6265801UF1366N_part5 as the boundary. 18 November 2026.

walls.name: Elena north mouth · white patio wall with the CALLE DE ELENA plaque and a brown double door, round the west corner onto Cervantes
walls.basis: Encloses the walled patio with the magnolia between the house (registry 6265201UF1366N_part4, corner -150.01, 48.72), Elena north and Cervantes. IMG_2455, IMG_2800 and IMG_2965-2967 (on Cervantes, looking west) show the white wall facing the Elena north lane behind the fan-palm bed, with the CALLE DE ELENA tiles, the bracket lamp at its corner and a brown double door near its north end; IMG_2463 shows it turning west along Cervantes behind the hedge to the Elena 24 garden door. The aerial shows the magnolia canopy filling the pocket. The Elena face continues the registry house front line (2.24 m west of the Elena north centreline); the Cervantes face runs 2.07 m north of the Cervantes axis to the Elena 24 garden-door wall (2.0 m) and beside the existing patio partition (2.14 m). Height 2.2 m as the CALLE ELENA wall across the lane, its top hidden by bougainvillea; door width read against the plaque tiles. Estimated to about 0.5 m; no solved camera sees it.
